title: Idioms and sayings
description: Colourful expressions Norwegians use, and what they really mean.

en: to be tough and decisive (lit. to have bone in the nose)
to speak your mind (lit. straight from the liver)

words.no: å ta seg vann over hodet
en: to bite off more than you can chew

words.no: å være ute på tynn is
en: to be on thin ice
It comes to nothing.
It fizzles out.

words.no: å skjære alle over én kam
en: to lump everyone together
No worries, there's no rush. (lit. no cow on the ice)

words.no: å slå to fluer i én smekk
en: to kill two birds with one stone

words.no: å passe som hånd i hanske
en: to fit like a glove
It's not as easy as it sounds.
to keep up (lit. to hang on in the bends)

words.no: å ta noe med en klype salt
en: to take something with a pinch of salt
to get cold feet
to be in the perfect spot (lit. in the middle of the butter eye)
to have something on the tip of your tongue
It's hard for them to do or admit it.
to suffer a setback
to come a cropper

words.no: å komme som julekvelden på kjerringa
en: to come as a (needless) surprise (lit. like Christmas Eve on the old woman)
to change your views to suit the situation
Something fishy is going on. (lit. owls in the moss)
to imagine the worst (lit. to paint the devil on the wall)

words.no: å ikke se skogen for bare trær
en: to not see the wood for the trees
to grit your teeth
to come back down to earth
to do a reality check
to admit you were wrong and apologize

words.no: å ha mange baller i lufta
en: to have a lot of balls in the air
to be way off the mark (lit. to be on a berry trip)
to throw in the towel
There's no place like home.

words.no: Den som venter på noe godt, venter ikke forgjeves.
en: Good things come to those who wait.
All good things come in threes.
Practice makes perfect.

words.no: Det er ikke gull alt som glimrer.
en: All that glitters is not gold.

sentences.en: Take it easy, there's no rush.
no: Ta det med ro, det er ingen ko på isen.
Ta det rolig, det er ingen ko på isen.
Hun snakker virkelig rett fra levra.
Hun snakker virkelig rett fra leveren.

sentences.en: I think he has bitten off more than he can chew.
no: Jeg tror han har tatt seg vann over hodet.
Jeg tror at han har tatt seg vann over hodet.
Ikke skjær alle over én kam.
Ikke skjær alle over en kam.

sentences.en: We killed two birds with one stone.
no: Vi slo to fluer i én smekk.
Vi slo to fluer i en smekk.

sentences.en: Take that rumour with a pinch of salt.
no: Ta det ryktet med en klype salt.

sentences.en: He got cold feet just before the wedding.
no: Han fikk kalde føtter rett før bryllupet.
Han fikk kalde føtter like før bryllupet.

sentences.en: The word is on the tip of my tongue.
no: Jeg har ordet på tunga.
Jeg har ordet på tungen.

sentences.en: Something fishy is going on here.
no: Her er det ugler i mosen.
Det er ugler i mosen her.

sentences.en: Don't imagine the worst, it will probably be fine.
no: Ikke mal fanden på veggen, det går nok bra.
Ikke mal fanden på veggen, det går sikkert bra.

sentences.en: Learning Norwegian is not as easy as it sounds.
no: Det er ikke bare bare å lære norsk.
Øvelse gjør mester.
